title: Method and system for placing a purchase order via a communications network
abstract: A method and system for placing an order to purchase an item via the Internet where a purchaser at a client system sends purchaser information to a server system. The server assigns a client identifier, associates it with purchaser details, and sends an HTML document with an order button. Upon button selection, the client sends a purchase request using the stored identifier, allowing the server to combine stored purchaser information with item details to complete the order without retransmitting sensitive data.
gist: This patent describes a single-action ordering system that enables customers to purchase items with minimal interactions. After initial registration, customers can order by performing one action (like clicking a button), with the server automatically retrieving stored billing and shipping information.
